# Anime fixtures

Real inputs, captured 2026-09-27, that the `/api/*/anime` and anime mapping tests are
driven from. Nothing here is hand-written. Upstream bodies were requested from dmm-01,
production's egress, because the community Stremio addon answers that address
differently from a residential one.

| File                                         | Source                                                                                                                                           | Why it is here                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `search-anime-frieren.json`                  | `https://debridmediamanager.com/api/search/anime?keyword=frieren`                                                                                | The ids search hands out: `anime:anidb-17617` and three `anime:mal-*`. `/api/info/anime` accepted only Kitsu ids, so every one of them rendered as the "Unknown" placeholder with a random picsum image.                                                                                               |
| `anime-rows-search-frieren.json`             | `Anime` rows behind those four ids, selected as `getAnimeByExternalId` selects them                                                              | Each carries the `kitsu_id` that translates a search id into the id space both metadata upstreams use. Frieren's `imdb_id` is still null here; the Fribb sync had never been applied.                                                                                                                  |
| `kitsu-anime-{46474,48105,48113,48642}.json` | `https://kitsu.io/api/edge/anime/{id}`                                                                                                           | Kitsu's answer for each of those rows. The addon returns 403 to dmm-01, so this is the source production renders from.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `addon-search-zzqqxxnotananime-403.html`     | `https://anime-kitsu.strem.fun/catalog/anime/kitsu-anime-list/search=zzqqxxnotananime.json`                                                      | Cloudflare's block page, which is what the addon answers dmm-01 for every request. The requesting address and Ray ID are replaced with `[redacted]`; nothing else is changed.                                                                                                                          |
| `kitsu-search-zzqqxxnotananime.json`         | `https://kitsu.io/api/edge/anime?filter%5Btext%5D=zzqqxxnotananime&page%5Blimit%5D=20`                                                           | Kitsu's valid "no matches" (`data: []`, `count: 0`). Together with the block page, search read it as both upstreams failing and answered 500.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `addon-search-fate-zero.json`                | `https://anime-kitsu.strem.fun/catalog/anime/kitsu-anime-list/search=fate/zero.json`, then with the slash as `%2F`                               | Captured from a residential address, since the addon refuses dmm-01 outright. The keyword pasted into the path raw is a 404; encoded, it returns 11 titles. Both answers are recorded as received.                                                                                                     |
| `scrapedtrue-anime-anidb-17617.json`         | `SELECT value FROM ScrapedTrue WHERE key = 'anime:anidb-17617'`                                                                                  | Frieren's 772 stored releases, all `{hash, filename, size_bytes}` with the size in MiB. Every anime row in production had this shape; none had `title`.                                                                                                                                                |
| `scrapedtrue-page0-anime-anidb-17617.json`   | The exact JSON_TABLE page query `getScrapedTrueResults` runs, for the same key, page 0                                                           | `[{"value":null}]`: the query projects `$.title`/`$.fileSize`, so every legacy entry is null-titled and filtered out. `/api/torrents/anime` answered 204 "requested" for a title with 772 releases.                                                                                                    |
| `anime-episode-releases.json`                | Six entries from production's `anime:anidb-{17617,69,18117}` rows, selected by hash                                                              | Single-file releases, so each name is the filename Real-Debrid's unrestrict answer carries. Four number the episode absolutely (`Sousou no Frieren - 05`, `One Piece - 1100`) and parse to no season, which the anime cast route rejected; two name `S01E03` and always worked.                        |
| `fribb-conflicting-ids.json`                 | Five `Anime` rows from production (id columns only) and every entry of the Fribb dataset at commit `8e4ec6a2` that shares one of their ids       | "Geu Yeoreum", "Heart Cocktail Again" and "Genshin Impact" each match one entry on their first id while another of their own ids belongs to a different entry; the sync filled them from the first. "Ameku Takao no Suiri Karte" differs only by a renamed anime-planet slug and must still be filled. |
| `fribb-shared-imdb.json`                     | Nine `Anime` rows from production and the Fribb entries (commit `8e4ec6a2`) that share their ids                                                 | Seven `.hack//` entries name `tt0361140` and A3!'s two seasons name `tt11094154`; the column is unique, so one row gets each. The sync gave it to the lowest row id: the `.hack//G.U. Returner` OVA and A3!'s second season.                                                                           |
| `anime-rows-kitsu-fate-zero.json`            | `getAnimeByKitsuIds`'s `findMany` against production for the eleven Kitsu ids the addon ranked for "fate/zero", in the order MySQL returned them | Rows come back in kitsu_id order, not the addon's ranking, so Gravitation (kitsu 218) headed a "Fate/Zero" search and every anime search was ordered by Kitsu id.                                                                                                                                      |

## Importer fixtures

Captured 2026-09-27 for `src/services/anime/animeImport.test.ts`. Each excerpt keeps the
source's own bytes for the entries listed; nothing inside an entry is edited.

| File                        | Source                                                                                                                                                                                          | Why it is here                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `anidb-titles-excerpt.dat`  | `https://anidb.net/api/anime-titles.dat.gz` (created 2026-09-27 03:00 UTC), the header plus every line for anidb 16388, 17617, 18560, 18700, 18729, 18756, 18886, 19067, 19972, 20331 and 20419 | The dump named 17,007 entries up to aid 20419 while the table's newest was 20328 and 3,527 had no row. These cover each outcome: Frieren (has a row), its 2026 second season and Ranma 1/2's three seasons (inserted), an adult entry, one Fribb has not mapped yet, one mapped to MAL only, one whose only Kitsu poster cannot be stored, and two rows the refresh titles. |
| `anime-lists-excerpt.xml`   | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Anime-Lists/anime-lists/master/anime-list-master.xml`, the `<anime>` elements for the same eleven ids                                                        | `tvdbid="hentai"` on 18756 is AniDB's adult flag and the only one available for an entry without a Kitsu id: it marked 1,274 of the 3,527 missing entries, against 15 of the 13,483 already in the table.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `fribb-import-entries.json` | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fribb/anime-lists/master/anime-list-full.json` (build of 2026-09-23), every entry sharing an anidb, kitsu, mal or imdb id with the rows and entries above    | Frieren's second season names the first season's `tt22248376`; Ranma 1/2's 2024, 2025 and 2026 seasons all name `tt32766897`, and none of the three had a row.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kitsu-import-batch.json`   | `https://kitsu.io/api/edge/anime?filter[id]=46474,48981,49008,49090,49240,49433,49759,50626,50629&page[limit]=20&fields[anime]=...`, the importer's own request                                 | Kitsu's answer for every Kitsu id above. 49008's only poster is a 396-character presigned Backblaze URL, which neither fits `poster_url` (191) nor stays valid (`X-Amz-Expires=900`). Its `X-Amz-Credential` and `X-Amz-Signature` values are masked with `x` at their original length.                                                                                     |
| `anime-rows-import.json`    | `SELECT * FROM Anime WHERE id IN (11142, 11867, 15346, 16587)` against production                                                                                                               | Frieren's complete row, Thunderbolt Fantasy's with a title and no poster, and two with an empty title: one with only a Kitsu id and one with only an anidb id. 13,143 rows had no poster and 12,099 no title, so search could not return them.                                                                                                                              |

## Stremio fixtures

Captured 2026-09-27 for the DMM Cast stream routes (`src/test/api/stremio/anime-streams.test.ts`,
`src/services/anime/stremioAnime.test.ts`). The meta files keep only each video's routing fields
(`id`, `season`, `episode`, `imdbSeason`, `imdbEpisode`, `title`, `released`) and the manifest only
its `id`, `version`, `resources`, `types` and `idPrefixes`; the values are as received.

| File                                               | Source                                                                                                        | Why it is here                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stremio-anime-kitsu-manifest.json`                | `https://anime-kitsu.strem.fun/manifest.json`                                                                 | The anime catalog in Stremio's own addon collection. It resolves `kitsu`, `mal`, `anilist` and `anidb` ids; every DMM Cast manifest accepted `tt` alone, so Stremio never sent DMM an anime stream request. |
| `stremio-anime-kitsu-meta-series-kitsu-46474.json` | `https://anime-kitsu.strem.fun/meta/series/kitsu:46474.json`                                                  | Frieren's 28 episodes as Stremio plays them: `kitsu:46474:1` ... `kitsu:46474:28`, the ids a stream request carries.                                                                                        |
| `stremio-anime-kitsu-meta-movie-kitsu-50942.json`  | `https://anime-kitsu.strem.fun/meta/movie/kitsu:50942.json`                                                   | A film's stream id is its bare `kitsu:50942`. It had no `Anime` row that day.                                                                                                                               |
| `stremio-anime-kitsu-meta-by-other-ids.json`       | The same addon's `meta/series/{mal:52991,anidb:17617,anilist:154587}.json`, `meta.id` and every `videos[].id` | Asked by mal, anidb or anilist id, the addon answers with Kitsu video ids, so those prefixes reach a stream route only from catalogs that also serve their own meta.                                        |
| `scrapedtrue-anime-anidb-18302.json`               | `SELECT value FROM ScrapedTrue WHERE key = 'anime:anidb-18302'`                                               | Honzuki no Gekokujou's fourth part: 64 releases, `S4 - 23` and `S04E23` for its own episodes and one `S01E23` from a group that numbers the part as its own season, plus Erai-raws' `- 23` absolute names.  |

## Anime pages

Captured 2026-09-27 for the `/anime/[anidbid]` page and the links to it. Database rows
were read with a read-only session against production's `dmmdb`; upstream bodies were
requested from dmm-01.

| File                                                           | Source                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Why it is here                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `api-info-browse-anime.json`                                   | `https://debridmediamanager.com/api/info/browse?search=anime`                                                                                                                                                                      | 96 items; 12 have a colon in their title, and /browse dropped all 12 (Frieren among them).                                                                                                                          |
| `scrapedtrue-anime-anidb-{18302,17052}.json`                   | `SELECT value FROM ScrapedTrue WHERE key = 'anime:anidb-{aid}'`                                                                                                                                                                    | Bookworm's fourth season (64 releases) and a 229-release ONA with no IMDb id anywhere.                                                                                                                              |
| `anime-release-names.json`                                     | 47 names from production's `anime:anidb-*` rows, one per shape, each with the answer read by hand                                                                                                                                  | The episode parser's cases: `- 05`, `S4 - 23`, `S04E23`, `17v2`, `01 ~ 28`, `[1-8 из 24]`, `Part 2 - 08`, `26.5.2`, `全8話`, films and BD volumes. Drawn from 300 random entries (14,360 names) and the rows above. |
| `fribb-franchises.json`                                        | Every entry of the Fribb dataset at commit `8e4ec6a2` naming `tt10885406`, `tt22248376` or `tt26743760`, the two ONAs below, three entries naming `""`, one naming two IMDb ids (and that id's siblings), and one with no AniDB id | The only relation between AniDB entries DMM can read: Bookworm is five entries under one IMDb id, Frieren three, Apothecary four. The `""` entries are why an empty id must not count as shared.                    |
| `anime-rows-franchises.json`                                   | `getAnimeEntryRows`'s select against production for those AniDB ids and IMDb ids, in the order MySQL returned them                                                                                                                 | Titles and posters for the links. 18302 is typed `SPECIAL` here and `TV` everywhere else; 18886, 19977, 19444 and 19671 have no row at all.                                                                         |
| `kitsu-anime-{49240,50629,50021,50896}.json`                   | `https://kitsu.io/api/edge/anime/{id}` from dmm-01                                                                                                                                                                                 | Kitsu's titles for the four seasons the table has no row for, found through the dataset's Kitsu id.                                                                                                                 |
| `kitsu-anime-{48293,45946}.json`                               | Same                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Bookworm's fourth season (TV, 24 episodes) and Dou Po Cangqiong: Nian Fan (ONA, no IMDb id).                                                                                                                        |
| `api-info-anime-anidb-{17617,18302,17052,18886,99999999}.json` | `https://debridmediamanager.com/api/info/anime?animeid=anidb-{aid}` before this change                                                                                                                                             | What the page reads today, without `type` or `episodeCount`. 18886 has no row, so production answered it with the placeholder.                                                                                      |
| `api-search-anime-bookworm.json`                               | `https://debridmediamanager.com/api/search/anime?keyword=bookworm`                                                                                                                                                                 | Eleven AniDB ids and two `anime:mal-*` rows, which have no anime page to link to.                                                                                                                                   |
